title: Ngai Shing NS-82
subtitle: Collar Blocking / Pressing Machine (NS-82P-L-2)

purposeAndApplication.purpose: The Ngai Shing NS-82 (variant NS-82P-L-2) is a collar-blocking and heat-pressing machine used in shirt production to press fused or sewn collars into their final shape after assembly. It uses an electrically heated mould and a single-chip microprocessor with a touch-screen control to maintain consistent temperature and shape.
applications: Heat-pressing shirt collars into final shape after assembly
Setting fused interlining on shirt collars (post-fusing finishing press)
Auxiliary operation in shirt-making lines alongside collar trim/turn (NS-76) and placket sewer (NS-6065J)

overviewDescription: The Ngai Shing NS-82 (NS-82P-L-2) is a collar-blocking and pressing machine. It uses an electrically heated mould — with an independent digital thermostat for precise temperature control — and a lower mould that has a selector / adjustment for different collar shapes. The machine is controlled by a single-chip microprocessor with a user-friendly touch-screen interface. It belongs to the same family of shirt-making auxiliary equipment as the NS-76 collar trimmer/turner and the NS-6065J placket sewer.

finalNotes:
• The NS-82 is the dedicated collar-blocking step in a shirt-making line — it pairs with the NS-76 (collar trim/turn) and NS-6065J (placket sewer) to form a complete collar / placket production cell.
• Ngai Shing is a shirt-making auxiliary equipment manufacturer widely used in Asian shirt factories.
• Phase 1 PARTIAL PASS — Ngai Shing's vendor identity and family of shirt-making auxiliary equipment confirmed via YouTube channel and ngaishing.com (Tier-1). Specific numeric spec sheet for the NS-82 collar blocker (temperature range, dimensions, weight) was not surfaced in Tier-1 material — recommend direct vendor query for the NS-82 spec sheet.
